description.zh: 工作项大类型，需求为Req，缺陷为Bug，任务为Task，风险为Risk，原始诉求为Request，主题为Topic
description.en: The main category of work items: Req for requirements, Bug for defects, Task for tasks, Risk for threats, Request for original requests, and Topic for subjects.

description.zh:
过滤条件，可以参考页面上的工作项列表中请求workitem/list的搜索参数。
注意：里面的人员id，要为阿里云accountID，即账号ID
description.en:
Filter conditions. You can refer to the search parameters of the workitem/list request in the work item list on the page.  
Note: The user IDs included must be Alibaba Cloud Account IDs.

description.zh: 额外条件，当该字段不为空时，conditions也不能为空
description.en: Extra conditions. When this field is not empty, the conditions field cannot be empty.

description.zh:
分组条件，可以参考页面上的工作项列表中请求workitem/list的搜索参数。
注意：里面的人员id，要为阿里云accountID，即账号ID
description.en:
Grouping condition. You can refer to the search parameters of the workitem/list request in the work item list on the page.  
Note: The user ID specified must be an Alibaba Cloud Account ID.

description.zh: 每页最大返回数量，0-200，默认值20
description.en: The maximum number of results returned per page, ranging from 0 to 200. Default value: 20.

description.zh: 第一页值不需要填写，后面每一页的值需要从前一次调用结果中获取到此字段，然后获取后面的分页数据
description.en: This field does not need to be specified for the first page. For subsequent pages, obtain this field from the result of the previous invocation to retrieve the next set of paginated data.

description.zh:
排序顺序，可以参考页面上的工作项列表中请求workitem/list的搜索参数。
注意：里面的人员id，要为阿里云accountID，即账号ID
description.en:
Sorting order. You can refer to the search parameters of the workitem/list request in the work item list on the page.  
Note: The user IDs included must be Alibaba Cloud Account IDs.

description.zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
description.en: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

description.zh: 搜索类型，默认是LIST，还可支持树形TREE等类型，具体更多参见页面请求的参数。
description.en: The search type. The default value is LIST. It also supports other types such as TREE. For more details, refer to the parameters in the page request.
Project ID, equivalent to projectId. This is the unique identifier of the project.
